```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Note: this schedule is subject to change. Please check for updates frequently!

Links under each lecture and lab go to its notes, WOD (warm-up exercise),
and lab handouts. Readings are posted on WebCampus.

```{r include=FALSE}
courseSchedule <- read.csv("CourseSchedule.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# materials linked under each cell: week (as in the CSV), column, label, file
links <- read.csv(text = '
week,col,label,href
Aug. 24,Lecture 1,Notes,INTRO.html
Aug. 24,Lecture 1,WOD: Self-diagnostic,wod/WOD_Week1_Lecture1_Diagnostic.pdf
Aug. 24,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab1_Act1.pdf
Aug. 24,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab1_Act2.pdf
Aug. 24,Lab,Act 3,labs/Lab1_Act3.pdf
Aug. 24,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE1.html
Aug. 24,Lecture 2,WOD: Permutation pseudocode,wod/WOD_Week1_Lecture2_PermutationPseudocode.pdf
Aug. 31,Lecture 1,WOD: R syntax and notation,wod/WOD_Week2_Lecture1_RSyntaxAndNotation.pdf
Aug. 31,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab2_Act1.pdf
Aug. 31,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab2_Act2.pdf
Aug. 31,Lab,Act 3,labs/Lab2_Act3.pdf
Aug. 31,Lecture 2,WOD: Limits and a derivative,wod/WOD_Week2_Lecture2_BestiaryLimits.pdf
Sept. 7,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab3_Act1.pdf
Sept. 7,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab3_Act2.pdf
Sept. 7,Lab,Act 3,labs/Lab3_Act3.pdf
Sept. 7,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE2.html
Sept. 7,Lecture 2,WOD: A probability puzzle,wod/WOD_Week3_Lecture2_ProbabilityPuzzle.pdf
Sept. 14,Lecture 1,Notes,LECTURE2.html
Sept. 14,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE2.html
Sept. 14,Lecture 2,WOD: Expectation and the sample mean,wod/WOD_Week4_Lecture2_SampleMeanVariance.pdf
Sept. 21,Lecture 1,Notes,LECTURE3.html
Sept. 21,Lecture 1,WOD: Choosing a data-generating model,wod/WOD_Week5_Lecture1_ChooseDataGeneratingModel.pdf
Sept. 21,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab4_Act1.pdf
Sept. 21,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE4.html
Sept. 21,Lecture 2,WOD: Writing the likelihood,wod/WOD_Week5_Lecture2_WritingTheLikelihood.pdf
Sept. 28,Lecture 1,Notes,LECTURE4.html
Sept. 28,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab5_Act1.pdf
Sept. 28,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab5_Act2.pdf
Sept. 28,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE3.html
Sept. 28,Lecture 2,WOD: Find the bugs,wod/WOD_Week6_Lecture2_FindTheBugs.pdf
Oct. 5,Lecture 1,Notes,LECTURE4.html
Oct. 5,Lecture 1,WOD: Reading the interval,wod/WOD_Week7_Lecture1_ReadTheInterval.pdf
Oct. 5,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab6_Act1.pdf
Oct. 5,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab6_Act2.pdf
Oct. 5,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE6.html
Oct. 12,Lecture 1,Notes,LECTURE6.html
Oct. 12,Lecture 1,WOD: How much did the prior matter?,wod/WOD_Week8_Lecture1_HowMuchDidThePriorMatter.pdf
Oct. 12,Lecture 1,WOD: Newton\'s method by hand (take-home),wod/WOD_Week8_Lecture1_NewtonByHand.pdf
Oct. 12,Lecture 2,Notes,LECTURE5.html
Oct. 12,Lecture 2,WOD: Curvature by hand (optional take-home),wod/WOD_Week8_Lecture2_CurvatureByHand.pdf
Oct. 19,Lecture 1,Notes,Week9_MCMC.html#metropolis
Oct. 19,Lab,Notes,Week9_MCMC.html#log-scale
Oct. 19,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab7_Act1.pdf
Oct. 19,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab7_Act2.pdf
Oct. 19,Lecture 2,Notes,Week9_MCMC.html#hmc
Oct. 19,Lecture 2,WOD: Getting Stan running (take-home),wod/WOD_Week9_Lecture2_GettingStanRunning.pdf
Oct. 19,Lecture 2,cmdstanr quick start,lecture_notes/NOTES_Reference_CmdstanrQuickStart.pdf
Oct. 26,Lecture 1,Notes,Week10_ModelComparison.html#frequentist
Oct. 26,Lecture 1,WOD: Connect the dots,wod/WOD_Week10_Lecture1_ConnectTheDots.pdf
Oct. 26,Lab,Notes,Week10_ModelComparison.html#lab-tools
Oct. 26,Lab,Act 1,labs/Lab8_Act1.pdf
Oct. 26,Lab,Act 2,labs/Lab8_Act2.pdf
Oct. 26,Lecture 2,Notes,Week10_ModelComparison.html#dags
', strip.white = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(links$week %in% courseSchedule$Week),
          all(file.exists(sub("#.*", "", links$href))))

# append each cell's links below its topic
for (i in seq_len(nrow(links))) {
  r <- match(links$week[i], courseSchedule$Week)
  courseSchedule[r, links$col[i]] <- paste0(courseSchedule[r, links$col[i]], "<br>",
                                            "[", links$label[i], "](", links$href[i], ")")
}
```

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(courseSchedule,caption="",col.names=c(
  "Week","Lecture 1","Lab","Lecture 2","Readings"
  )
)

```
